constituencies.forkmesh-maintainer: Holds write access to the forkmesh/forkmesh main branch or is paid by the entity that operates forkmesh.com.
constituencies.independent-implementer: Maintains a client, relay, mirror, index, or verifier that is not ForkMesh code, has a public https source, and holds or is pursuing a certification badge. Is not paid by the entity that operates forkmesh.com.
constituencies.community-operator: Operates a public mirror, relay, gateway, or moderation service used by people other than themselves. Is not paid by the entity that operates forkmesh.com.
constituencies.community-member: Holds an active ForkMesh identity with signed contribution history and no other seat.

protectedRights.statement: Implementing, running, and certifying the protocol requires no payment, license fee, plan, or account on a ForkMesh-operated service.
An identity and its signed history can be exported, recovered, and used with any conforming implementation without the operator's permission.
Git data and signed collaboration records can be read, cloned, and moved off any host, including forkmesh.com, without a paid plan.
No token, asset holding, payment, plan, or funding amount grants a seat, a vote, standing to appeal, or weight in any decision.

moderationBaseline: Every moderation action on a signed collaboration record is itself a signed record naming the moderator key and the policy rule applied.
Hiding content never deletes the underlying signed record; another host may serve it under its own policy.
A person whose content or account is actioned is told the rule applied and may appeal under the appeal process.
Operators publish their own moderation policy; the baseline is a floor, not a ceiling, and never binds another operator's host.

succession.interimHolder: When a seat is vacant, it counts as absent. Its constituency's quorum requirement blocks decisions that need it, and no other constituency fills it.
succession.stewardshipTransfer: If the entity operating forkmesh.com stops operating, the protocol council holds the suite, vectors, and certification registry. Any member may republish them under the MIT license.
